# eCAD-Hardware-Products

> llms.txt for the eCAD-Hardware-Products repository (embeddedos-org/eCAD-Hardware-Products).
> Status: the hardware-design repository of EmbeddedOS —
> board designs, datasheets and EE documentation, with the
> devboard CAD database and dataset-engineering docs as the
> primary corpus. The multi-domain dataset plan
> (ECAD_MULTI_DOMAIN_DATASET_PLAN.md, ~155 KB) is linked from
> the README and deliberately not duplicated into llms-full.txt.

eCAD-Hardware-Products is where the EmbeddedOS ecosystem's
physical layer lives: the designs EoS, eBoot and eFirmware
run on, the devboard CAD database, and the validation
contract hardware must meet.

## Docs

- [Development-Board CAD Database (issue #28)](docs/devboard-cad-database.md)
- [CAD dataset and engineering model v1](docs/cad-dataset-engineering-model-v1.md)
- [Hardware validation contract v1](docs/hardware-validation-contract-v1.md)
- [Digital / FPGA domain design (final): `uart_loopback_001` on Icarus Verilog](docs/design/digital-domain-design.md)
- [Electrical domain design (final): `servo_supply_001` on ngspice](docs/design/electrical-domain-design.md)

## Machine-readable

- [llms.txt](llms.txt) — this file
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — the docs above concatenated as one document
